roadmap.title: Base story and collections
roadmap.description: Play the 13 base-game levels on Hard difficulty and gather every level-experience pickup and secret chest. Most story, collection, and combat achievements unlock here.

roadmap.title: Goblin Menace expansion
roadmap.description: Play the 6 expansion levels and the Dwarven Caverns bonus, collecting all expansion experience and chests and finishing the expansion combat achievements.

roadmap.title: Hardcore runs
roadmap.description: Complete levels and full campaigns with hardcore mode enabled on Hard difficulty, when death ends the attempt.

roadmap.title: Solo-character runs
roadmap.description: Replay levels while controlling only one hero, never switching characters mid-level.

roadmap.title: Completion cleanup
roadmap.description: Earn any remaining challenge achievements, then the two completion achievements that require every other unlock.

achievements.description: Stand on a plank floating on a single airflow for four seconds
achievements.summary: Ride a single airflow for four seconds while standing on a conjured plank.

guide.context: Requires Amadeus' plank skill. Pipes that push a single airflow appear at the end of @loc{Forlorn Wilderness} and in @loc{Mudwater Dale}; a smaller plank wobbles less.

steps.text: Stand on an airflow and conjure a small plank directly beneath your feet while the airflow lifts you.
Stay balanced on the plank for four seconds while it rides the airflow.

achievements.description: Make goblins die of three different environmental hazards in a single level
achievements.summary: Kill goblins with three different environmental hazards in one level.

guide.context: Amadeus' Monster Levitation can carry a goblin into spikes, a spitting plant, a carnivorous plant, a bottomless drop, or a flame mechanism. Any three different hazards in the same level count.

steps.text: In one level, levitate or lure goblins into three different hazards such as spikes, a fire mechanism and a bottomless drop.

achievements.description: Complete a whole level playing one character only
achievements.summary: Finish an entire level while controlling only one hero.

guide.context: Switching characters at any point, including at a checkpoint, marks the level as a multi-character run and forces a restart. Dying is allowed as long as you restore the previous checkpoint rather than swapping to a living hero.

steps.text: Pick an early non-tutorial level such as @loc{Forlorn Wilderness} and set the difficulty to Easy.
Complete the level without ever pressing the character-switch keys, including at checkpoints.

achievements.description: Feed carnivorous plants with three or more different kinds of treats
achievements.summary: Feed three or more kinds of treats to a carnivorous plant.

guide.context: Only @loc{Hushing Grove} has the giant carnivorous plant. Amadeus' Monster Levitation can move a goblin, a box, or a lantern into its mouth; a party member also counts as a treat if the count stalls.

steps.text: In @loc{Hushing Grove}, use Amadeus to carry three different things, such as a goblin, a box and a lantern, into the giant plant's mouth.
If no unlock appears after three different objects, feed one of the other heroes to the plant as well.

achievements.description: Shatter three frozen enemies within one second
achievements.summary: Destroy three frozen enemies all within one second.

guide.context: Zoya's frost arrows freeze enemies in place. Cluster at least three enemies before freezing them, then hit the whole group at once.

steps.text: Gather at least three enemies close together and freeze them with Zoya's frost arrows.
Switch to Pontius and throw a fully charged hammer into the frozen cluster so all three break in the same second.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a thrown hammer bouncing at least once before kill
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with a hammer throw that bounces at least once before the kill.

guide.context: The bounce can be off a ceiling or wall. Holding the enemy still makes the timing far easier.

steps.text: Pick a spot where a low ceiling or wall sits beside an enemy, then pin the enemy down with Amadeus' Monster Levitation.
As Pontius, throw the hammer so it bounces off the surface and strikes the held enemy.

achievements.description: Get at least 10 enemies killed by other enemies' actions in a single level
achievements.summary: Have 10 or more enemies killed by other enemies in a single level.

guide.context: Amadeus' Monster Levitation turns an enemy into a shield that arrows and spears hit, so each stray shot becomes a kill credited to another enemy.

steps.text: In a level with many ranged goblins, use Monster Levitation to hold one enemy in front of you as a shield.
Keep the shield up while archers and spear throwers fire, letting their hits kill 10 enemies.

achievements.description: Stand on a conjured box bouncing on any bouncy surface for 10 seconds
achievements.summary: Stay on a conjured box that is bouncing on a bouncy surface for 10 seconds.

guide.context: The mushroom section of @loc{Forlorn Wilderness} is the usual spot. Keep re-conjuring and re-mounting until the box and you stay on for the full count.

steps.text: Conjure a box onto a bouncy mushroom and stand on top of it.
Ride the bouncing box for 10 seconds without falling off.

achievements.description: Shoot 3 arrows in the air and catch them all with the Knight's shield
achievements.summary: Shoot three arrows into the air and catch all three arrows on Pontius' shield.

guide.context: Shoot the arrows straight up so they fall back close to you, then hold the shield out and stand under the landing spot.

steps.text: As Zoya, send three arrows of the frost or fire type vertically upward.
Switch to Pontius, hold out the shield, and stand beneath the falling arrows so all three land on it.
If any arrow misses, fire another three and try again.

achievements.description: Construct a tower made of eight objects and stand on top of it
achievements.summary: Build a tower from eight objects and stand on the top.

guide.context: In @loc{Petrified Tree} the rotating-flamethrower room holds a box dispenser. The dispenser refills one box at a time, so do not destroy its spawns.

steps.text: In the box-dispenser room of @loc{Petrified Tree}, conjure boxes and planks and stack them into a tower of at least eight objects.
Climb the stack and stand on the top piece.

achievements.description: Using grapple, swing around an object and reattach grapple again without touching any surface
achievements.summary: Swing the grapple a full circle around an object and reattach it without touching any surface.

guide.context: A small fixed object such as a log works best. Keep swinging until the grapple passes all the way around, then re-fire it before your feet touch anything.

steps.text: Grapple a small object such as the candle log in the pipes area of @loc{Forlorn Wilderness}.
Swing a complete 360-degree circle around the object and reattach the grapple without landing.

achievements.description: Make a bubble sink for three seconds
achievements.summary: Force a bubble to sink and stay underwater for three seconds.

guide.context: A freshly formed bubble rises on its own, so weight it down immediately after it appears.

steps.text: As Amadeus, conjure a box and place it on top of a newly formed bubble, then drag the box down to push the bubble underwater.
Keep the bubble sunk for three seconds before releasing it.

achievements.description: Earn all (original) Achievements in Trine 2
achievements.summary: Earn every original base-game achievement in Trine 2.

guide.context: This unlocks once the last remaining base-game achievement is earned, sometimes a moment later.

steps.text: Unlock every other base-game achievement; this one unlocks last.

achievements.description: Complete the game
achievements.summary: Finish all 13 base story levels and watch the ending after The Final Chapter.

steps.text: Play through every base story level and watch the final cutscene after completing @loc{The Final Chapter}.

achievements.description: Complete The Story Begins
achievements.summary: Complete The Story Begins.

steps.text: Play through @loc{The Story Begins} and reach the end of Zoya's rooftop route.

achievements.description: Complete Forlorn Wilderness
achievements.summary: Complete Forlorn Wilderness.

steps.text: Reach the end of @loc{Forlorn Wilderness} and defeat the giant snake boss that blocks the exit.

achievements.description: Complete Mudwater Dale
achievements.summary: Complete Mudwater Dale.

steps.text: Reach the exit of @loc{Mudwater Dale} after the bubble and airflow sections.

achievements.description: Complete Mosslight Marsh
achievements.summary: Complete Mosslight Marsh.

steps.text: Reach the end of @loc{Mosslight Marsh}, defeating the armoured boss in the arena before the final gas-filled room.

achievements.description: Complete Petrified Tree
achievements.summary: Complete Petrified Tree.

steps.text: Reach the exit of @loc{Petrified Tree} past the counter-weighted platforms.

achievements.description: Complete Shadowed Halls
achievements.summary: Complete Shadowed Halls.

steps.text: Reach the exit of @loc{Shadowed Halls} through the portal rooms after the dragon.

achievements.description: Complete Hushing Grove
achievements.summary: Complete Hushing Grove.

steps.text: Reach the end of @loc{Hushing Grove} past the saw room and the boulder section.

achievements.description: Complete Mushroom Caves
achievements.summary: Complete Mushroom Caves.

steps.text: Reach the end of @loc{Mushroom Caves} past the poisonous-gas puzzle and the collapsible platforms.

achievements.description: Complete Mushroom Murk
achievements.summary: Complete Mushroom Murk.

steps.text: Reach the exit of @loc{Mushroom Murk} past the airflow cart and the bouncy mushrooms.

achievements.description: Complete Searock Castle
achievements.summary: Complete Searock Castle.

steps.text: Reach the end of @loc{Searock Castle} and defeat the Goblin King.
Fight the Goblin King from the left side of the arena and grapple the overhead platform to dodge his charges.

achievements.description: Complete Eldritch Passages
achievements.summary: Complete Eldritch Passages.

steps.text: Reach the exit of @loc{Eldritch Passages} after the acid and pipe rooms.

achievements.description: Complete Icewarden Keep
achievements.summary: Complete Icewarden Keep.

steps.text: Reach the end of @loc{Icewarden Keep}, defeating the armoured boss that breaks through the wall.

achievements.description: Complete The Final Chapter
achievements.summary: Complete The Final Chapter.

steps.text: Reach the end of @loc{The Final Chapter} and defeat the dragon Rosabel summons.

achievements.description: Collect all experience pickups in The Story Begins
achievements.summary: Collect every level-experience pickup in The Story Begins.

guide.context: Only the green level-experience pickups count toward this; enemy kills are tracked separately as monster experience. The @loc{Choose Level} screen shows a per-level counter, so any pickup missed on the first pass can be recovered by replaying the level.

steps.text: As Amadeus, collect the pickups around the mushroom caps and bubbles, pull the sky platform and the mushroom caps down, then use conjured boxes at the cliff and the swinging log.
As Pontius, slash the vines, climb the oversized pumpkin, push the straw cart onto the water wheel, then switch to the hammer to break the wall and shield against the falling rocks.
As Zoya, climb the mushrooms and cross the rope, shoot the lamp-post board from below, grapple the rooftop platforms and the clock tower, and grab the last pickup before the tower.

achievements.description: Collect all experience pickups in Forlorn Wilderness
achievements.summary: Collect every level-experience pickup in Forlorn Wilderness.

guide.context: Only the green level-experience pickups count toward this; enemy kills are tracked separately as monster experience. The @loc{Choose Level} screen shows a per-level counter, so any pickup missed on the first pass can be recovered by replaying the level.

steps.text: Pull the first mushroom cap down, grapple the swinging log to the plant leaves, then move the static log to reach the next leaves and the sky pickup.
Smash the statue and use the suspended log and flowing water to grow each sparkling plant, collecting the pickups this drops.
Wedge a wooden crate into the spiked plant, swing Zoya onto it for a cluster of pickups, then cross the seesaw and smash the statue.
Break the wooden walls and beams with the hammer, ride the boulder across the collapsible platforms, and grapple the upper platform pickups.
Use the bubbles and conjured boxes over the water and leaves to gather the airborne pickups, then finish at the bridge and the small exit platform.
After the checkpoint, use the pipes, curved pipe and an airflow to reach the sky pickups and the ledge pickups, then defeat the snake boss.

achievements.description: Collect all experience pickups in Mudwater Dale
achievements.summary: Collect every level-experience pickup in Mudwater Dale.

guide.context: Only the green level-experience pickups count toward this; enemy kills are tracked separately as monster experience. The @loc{Choose Level} screen shows a per-level counter, so any pickup missed on the first pass can be recovered by replaying the level.

steps.text: Shoot the beehive down and grapple the hanging crate for its pickups, then break the crate open.
Ride and grapple the spinning platforms and swinging logs around the two buttons, collecting the pickups they gate.
Use boxes and planks on the airflows, direct the curved pipes to move flames and lift the bridge, and collect the sky pickups.
Swim below the frog and check both underwater paths for pickups and a chest.
Use the bubbles, bouncy mushrooms and alcoves in the later rooms, then search the hidden passages behind the flames.

achievements.description: Collect all experience pickups in Mosslight Marsh
achievements.summary: Collect every level-experience pickup in Mosslight Marsh.

guide.context: Only the green level-experience pickups count toward this; enemy kills are tracked separately as monster experience. The @loc{Choose Level} screen shows a per-level counter, so any pickup missed on the first pass can be recovered by replaying the level.

steps.text: Break the beams over the poisonous-gas gap and time the jumps past the plant's fireballs to take the airborne pickups.
Search the hidden upper area reached by grappling, then block fireballs with boxes and shields to break the planks above.
Push a crate into the spiked plant and use it to grapple and climb for the upper pickups.
Use the bubbles, the large log and the bouncy mushrooms to reach the high pickups, then finish the boss arena.
Collect the pickups in the gas-covered final room by grappling the beam above and using boxes and plants.

achievements.description: Collect all experience pickups in Petrified Tree
achievements.summary: Collect every level-experience pickup in Petrified Tree.

guide.context: Only the green level-experience pickups count toward this; enemy kills are tracked separately as monster experience. The @loc{Choose Level} screen shows a per-level counter, so any pickup missed on the first pass can be recovered by replaying the level.

steps.text: Ride the cauldron bubbles and use the blue mirror as a portal to press the button and open the exit.
Unfold the floor panels, use the curved pipes to move the flames, and heat the cauldron for more bubbles.
Cross the spinning-flame and spinning-wheel rooms behind Pontius' shield and use the portals to gather the airborne pickups.
Search the library and the hidden room beside the bouncy object, then grapple the platforms above.
Balance the counter-weighted platforms and hold the floor button to collect the last pickups.

achievements.description: Collect all experience pickups in Shadowed Halls
achievements.summary: Collect every level-experience pickup in Shadowed Halls.

guide.context: Only the green level-experience pickups count toward this; enemy kills are tracked separately as monster experience. The @loc{Choose Level} screen shows a per-level counter, so any pickup missed on the first pass can be recovered by replaying the level.

steps.text: Place a conjured box on the glowing floor switch at the dragon's feet, then break the beams and follow the path to the checkpoint.
Move the contraption, cross the flames with the t-shaped pipe, and stack boxes to reach the upper level.
Cross the collapsible platforms, grapple the metal centres, and use boxes and planks to reach the airborne pickups.
Use the portals and bubble streams to ride up, then gather the pickups above the spinning flames.
Finish the portal puzzle to open the exit, then take the pickups on the spinning platforms in the blue room.

achievements.description: Collect all experience pickups in Hushing Grove
achievements.summary: Collect every level-experience pickup in Hushing Grove.

guide.context: Only the green level-experience pickups count toward this; enemy kills are tracked separately as monster experience. The @loc{Choose Level} screen shows a per-level counter, so any pickup missed on the first pass can be recovered by replaying the level.

steps.text: Grow the sparkling plants with water and boxes to take the leaf pickups, then climb the tree for another.
Block the cannons with boxes and climb them, then jump the leaves for the upper pickups.
Use Stealth Movement past the carnivorous plants and shoot the beams to drop the hidden pickups.
Search the water-wheel area, the hidden floor and the beams behind the saw.
Use the boulder and the middle platform to reach the pickups around the saw room and the water plant.

achievements.description: Collect all experience pickups in Mushroom Caves
achievements.summary: Collect every level-experience pickup in Mushroom Caves.

guide.context: Only the green level-experience pickups count toward this; enemy kills are tracked separately as monster experience. The @loc{Choose Level} screen shows a per-level counter, so any pickup missed on the first pass can be recovered by replaying the level.

steps.text: Break the beams in front of you and grapple the left platform, then cross the leaves and destroy the wall for the hidden pickups.
Bounce the mushrooms, weigh the platform with a box, and use the logs and grapples to gather the airborne pickups.
Place boxes in the poisonous gas, direct the airflow to clear it, then use the lever and grapple up.
Hold the platform with a plank, bridge to the sparkling plant, and destroy the beams and wall for the last pickups.

achievements.description: Collect all experience pickups in Mushroom Murk
achievements.summary: Collect every level-experience pickup in Mushroom Murk.

guide.context: Only the green level-experience pickups count toward this; enemy kills are tracked separately as monster experience. The @loc{Choose Level} screen shows a per-level counter, so any pickup missed on the first pass can be recovered by replaying the level.

steps.text: Shoot the rocks, ride the boulder, and use the cart and airflow to collect the pickups around the gas.
Create boxes and planks to divert the water to the sparkling plant, then bounce up for the pickups above.
Use the bouncy mushroom and box for the airborne pickups, then climb the cliff and swim for the last ones.

achievements.description: Collect all experience pickups in Searock Castle
achievements.summary: Collect every level-experience pickup in Searock Castle.

guide.context: Only the green level-experience pickups count toward this; enemy kills are tracked separately as monster experience. The @loc{Choose Level} screen shows a per-level counter, so any pickup missed on the first pass can be recovered by replaying the level.

steps.text: Swim the seabed and air pockets for the pickups, place a box on the crab, and collect around the structure.
Stop the swinging spike and build boxes to reach the high pickups, then open the hidden walls.
Use the cogs, airflow and barrels to reach the mid-level pickups and the hidden entrances.
Bounce the starfish, shoot the coconuts, and use the octopus platforms for the upper pickups.
Swim the lower caverns, open the clam, and gather the pickups around the pit and the raised water.
Use the boxes, bubbles and sparkling plant to take the last pickups before the Goblin King.

achievements.description: Collect all experience pickups in Eldritch Passages
achievements.summary: Collect every level-experience pickup in Eldritch Passages.

guide.context: Only the green level-experience pickups count toward this; enemy kills are tracked separately as monster experience. The @loc{Choose Level} screen shows a per-level counter, so any pickup missed on the first pass can be recovered by replaying the level.

steps.text: Arrange the airflow with the T-pipe and the bent pipe to make a climbable path, then stack boxes to reach the sky pickups.
Cross the acid while it is stopped, using planks and the lever, and shoot the ceiling for the hidden pickups.
Climb the cogs and the vertical shaft, stopping the cog with planks to reach the pickups above.
Move the block to sink the platform, then grapple the ceiling and break the statue for the water-area pickups.
Shoot stone blocks into the acid, then collect the final pickups and the painting before stopping the acid.

achievements.description: Collect all experience pickups in Icewarden Keep
achievements.summary: Collect every level-experience pickup in Icewarden Keep.

guide.context: Only the green level-experience pickups count toward this; enemy kills are tracked separately as monster experience. The @loc{Choose Level} screen shows a per-level counter, so any pickup missed on the first pass can be recovered by replaying the level.

steps.text: Break the ice and push the box into the spike, then grapple the balcony and break the ice walls.
Use the lava pipes and planks to cross, then collect the pickups around the spinning flames and cogs.
Cross the spinning-blades room with boxes and a plank, or use Pontius' charge or Kitesail.
Use the portals and lava flow to melt the ice, then collect the sky and spinning-platform pickups.
Collect the pickups around the finale, then defeat the boss and take the last pickup above the icy slide.

achievements.description: Find all chests in Forlorn Wilderness
achievements.summary: Find both secret chests in Forlorn Wilderness.

guide.context: Every level from 2 to 13 hides two secret chests, each holding one collectible poem or painting. The @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks them per level, so a missed chest is never lost permanently.

steps.text: Jump to the higher ledge to the right of the seesaw section and open the chest holding the @item{painting}.
Ride the bubbles above the log section up to the upper ledge and open the chest holding the @item{poem}.

achievements.description: Find all chests in Mudwater Dale
achievements.summary: Find both secret chests in Mudwater Dale.

guide.context: Every level from 2 to 13 hides two secret chests, each holding one collectible poem or painting. The @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks them per level, so a missed chest is never lost permanently.

steps.text: Swim into the right underwater path past the frog to open the chest holding the @item{poem}.
Near the level end, jump off the left platform into the hidden passage to open the chest holding the @item{painting}.

achievements.description: Find all chests in Mosslight Marsh
achievements.summary: Find both secret chests in Mosslight Marsh.

guide.context: Every level from 2 to 13 hides two secret chests, each holding one collectible poem or painting. The @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks them per level, so a missed chest is never lost permanently.

steps.text: From the checkpoint, leap the collapsing platforms on the left side and open the chest holding the @item{poem}.
Weight the right-hand bridge down with a box, cross it, and open the chest holding the @item{painting}.

achievements.description: Find all chests in Petrified Tree
achievements.summary: Find both secret chests in Petrified Tree.

guide.context: Every level from 2 to 13 hides two secret chests, each holding one collectible poem or painting. The @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks them per level, so a missed chest is never lost permanently.

steps.text: Build planks to cross to the platform past the secret area and open the chest holding the @item{painting}.
In the library, grapple the platform above and swing right to the far side of the room for the chest holding the @item{poem}.

achievements.description: Find all chests in Shadowed Halls
achievements.summary: Find both secret chests in Shadowed Halls.

guide.context: Every level from 2 to 13 hides two secret chests, each holding one collectible poem or painting. The @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks them per level, so a missed chest is never lost permanently.

steps.text: Stack two boxes and a plank on the right side of the mid-level to reach the chest holding the @item{poem}.
After the magical platforms, jump through the right wall into the hidden area for the chest holding the @item{painting}.

achievements.description: Find all chests in Hushing Grove
achievements.summary: Find both secret chests in Hushing Grove.

guide.context: Every level from 2 to 13 hides two secret chests, each holding one collectible poem or painting. The @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks them per level, so a missed chest is never lost permanently.

steps.text: Destroy the rocky ground to reveal a hidden path and open the chest holding the @item{painting}.
Go down to ground level, pass right through the cobwebs, and open the chest holding the second @item{painting}.

achievements.description: Find all chests in Mushroom Caves
achievements.summary: Find both secret chests in Mushroom Caves.

guide.context: Every level from 2 to 13 hides two secret chests, each holding one collectible poem or painting. The @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks them per level, so a missed chest is never lost permanently.

steps.text: Grapple up to the small platform on the left to open the chest holding the @item{poem}.
At the poisonous-gas section, blow the gas away with the airflow and grapple up to the chest holding the @item{painting}.

achievements.description: Find all chests in Mushroom Murk
achievements.summary: Find both secret chests in Mushroom Murk.

guide.context: Every level from 2 to 13 hides two secret chests, each holding one collectible poem or painting. The @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks them per level, so a missed chest is never lost permanently.

steps.text: Use a stack of two boxes plus a plank to slip into the hidden room behind the wall, then open the chest holding the @item{painting}.
Near the end, collect the pickup cluster and open the chest holding the @item{poem}.

achievements.description: Find all chests in Searock Castle
achievements.summary: Find both secret chests in Searock Castle.

guide.context: Every level from 2 to 13 hides two secret chests, each holding one collectible poem or painting. The @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks them per level, so a missed chest is never lost permanently.

steps.text: When the mini-boss jumps down, grapple up to the level above to open the chest holding the @item{painting}.
Ride the platform wrapped by the octopus up to the airborne pickup, then leap left to the chest holding the @item{poem}.

achievements.description: Find all chests in Eldritch Passages
achievements.summary: Find both secret chests in Eldritch Passages.

guide.context: Every level from 2 to 13 hides two secret chests, each holding one collectible poem or painting. The @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks them per level, so a missed chest is never lost permanently.

steps.text: After the spinning-platform section, grapple up to the right platform and open the chest holding the @item{poem}.
In the acid-filled room, drop stone blocks into the acid and open the chest holding the @item{painting}.

achievements.description: Find all chests in Icewarden Keep
achievements.summary: Find both secret chests in Icewarden Keep.

guide.context: Every level from 2 to 13 hides two secret chests, each holding one collectible poem or painting. The @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks them per level, so a missed chest is never lost permanently.

steps.text: In the lower lava-pipe area after the iced-over-cog elevator, place the t-shaped pipe flat in the lava and stack boxes to open the chest holding the @item{painting}.
In the upper portal area, break the ice holding the curved pipe and swing up to the chest holding the @item{poem}.

achievements.description: Find all chests in The Final Chapter
achievements.summary: Find both secret chests in The Final Chapter.

guide.context: Every level from 2 to 13 hides two secret chests, each holding one collectible poem or painting. The @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks them per level, so a missed chest is never lost permanently.

steps.text: At the start, drop left and grapple the lower platform, fire an Explosive Arrow at the wall, then re-grapple the tree and swing to the chest holding the @item{poem}.
Return to the start, head right for the chest holding the @item{painting}, then move the painting of the sisters to reveal the hidden path.

achievements.description: Collect all experience pickups in any level
achievements.summary: Collect every level-experience pickup in at least one level.

guide.context: Any single level qualifies, including the base story or an expansion level. The @loc{Choose Level} screen shows the per-level counter, so pick a short level and confirm it is complete.

steps.text: Choose the shortest available level and gather every green level-experience pickup in it.
Check the @loc{Choose Level} experience counter for that level to confirm it is full.

achievements.description: Collect all experience pickups in the game
achievements.summary: Collect every level-experience pickup in all 12 base-game levels that contain them.

guide.context: The Final Chapter (level 13) has no level-experience pickups at all, so only levels 1 through 12 count. The @loc{Choose Level} screen shows each level's counter and lets you replay any level.

steps.text: Finish every base level from The Story Begins through Icewarden Keep while taking all level-experience pickups.
Use @loc{Choose Level} to replay any level whose experience counter is not yet full.

achievements.description: Find all chests in the game
achievements.summary: Open every secret chest in the 12 base-game levels that have them.

guide.context: The Story Begins has no chests; every later base level from Forlorn Wilderness to The Final Chapter hides exactly two.

steps.text: Open both secret chests in each base level from Forlorn Wilderness through The Final Chapter.
Use @loc{Choose Level} to replay any level whose chest count is not two.

achievements.description: Freeze two enemies and stack them on top of each other
achievements.summary: Freeze two enemies and levitate one onto the other.

guide.context: Frozen enemies thaw after a short time, so work quickly or play in co-op so Amadeus and Zoya act at once.

steps.text: As Zoya, freeze two enemies that are standing close together.
Switch to Amadeus and quickly levitate one frozen enemy on top of the other.

achievements.description: Complete any level with hardcore mode on and difficulty set to hard
achievements.summary: Finish one level on Hard difficulty with hardcore mode enabled.

guide.context: Hardcore must be enabled before the attempt; a dead hero cannot be revived and the death screen offers no checkpoint restart. The easiest combat level for this is @loc{Forlorn Wilderness}.

steps.text: Start or replay a level with difficulty set to Hard and hardcore mode turned on.
Complete @loc{Forlorn Wilderness} without letting a hero stay dead.

achievements.description: Complete the game on hard using hardcore mode
achievements.summary: Finish the entire base story on Hard difficulty with hardcore mode enabled.

guide.context: This applies to the base story only, not the Goblin Menace expansion. Keep every hero alive, because hardcore gives no revives.

steps.text: Start a new base-game campaign on Hard with hardcore mode turned on.
Complete all 13 base story levels through @loc{The Final Chapter} without losing a hero.

achievements.description: Complete a level with only Amadeus
achievements.summary: Finish a level using only Amadeus.

guide.context: Switching characters at any point, including at a checkpoint, marks the level as a multi-character run and forces a restart. Dying is allowed as long as you restore the previous checkpoint rather than swapping to a living hero. Amadeus solves most puzzles with conjured boxes and planks but is weak in combat, so cage or levitate enemies instead of fighting them.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Forlorn Wilderness} on Easy without ever switching away from Amadeus; cage or levitate enemies to handle combat.

achievements.description: Complete a level with only Zoya
achievements.summary: Finish a level using only Zoya.

guide.context: Switching characters at any point, including at a checkpoint, marks the level as a multi-character run and forces a restart. Dying is allowed as long as you restore the previous checkpoint rather than swapping to a living hero. Zoya's low-gravity field arrow and fire arrows are her main tools for traversal and combat.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Forlorn Wilderness} on Easy without ever switching away from Zoya.

achievements.description: Complete a level with only Pontius
achievements.summary: Finish a level using only Pontius.

guide.context: Switching characters at any point, including at a checkpoint, marks the level as a multi-character run and forces a restart. Dying is allowed as long as you restore the previous checkpoint rather than swapping to a living hero. Pontius has no conjuring, so use his charge, hammer and Kitesail to bypass puzzles; a charge followed by a jump at the end adds distance across gaps.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Forlorn Wilderness} on Easy without ever switching away from Pontius.

achievements.description: Complete a level with only Amadeus, a level with only Zoya and a level with only Pontius
achievements.summary: Complete one level with only Amadeus, a different level with only Zoya, and another level with only Pontius.

guide.context: Switching characters at any point, including at a checkpoint, marks the level as a multi-character run and forces a restart. Dying is allowed as long as you restore the previous checkpoint rather than swapping to a living hero.

steps.text: Complete one level without switching away from Amadeus.
Complete one level without switching away from Zoya.
Complete one level without switching away from Pontius.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with an airborne object tossed with the Knight's charge
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with an object flung by the Knight's charge.

guide.context: The object must be a real box, not a conjured one, which shatters on impact. Charging from a slope and having a partner hold the enemy helps.

steps.text: As Pontius, charge into a solid box next to an enemy so the box flies into it.
Charge from a slope, and have Amadeus hold the enemy in place with Monster Levitation so it cannot dodge.

achievements.description: Finish a level without taking any damage (Not the Tutorial)
achievements.summary: Complete any non-tutorial level without any hero taking a single hit.

guide.context: The tutorial The Story Begins does not count. @loc{Mushroom Murk} is short, which keeps the risk low.

steps.text: Replay a short non-tutorial level such as @loc{Mushroom Murk} and complete it without letting any hero take a single hit.

achievements.description: Build a three-piece or three-character tower where lowest part is Pontius and his shield, tower must stand at least five seconds
achievements.summary: Build a tower of three pieces, or of three heroes, with Pontius and his shield at the base, and keep it standing for five seconds.

guide.context: Pontius should aim the shield straight up. Short planks make the stack more stable than long ones.

steps.text: Have Pontius hold his shield directly overhead.
As Amadeus, lower three planks or boxes onto the shield one at a time.
Keep the tower standing for five seconds.

achievements.description: Complete The Heroes Return
achievements.summary: Complete The Heroes Return.

steps.text: Play through @loc{The Heroes Return} and destroy the catapult tower the armoured boss guards.
Monster Prison lets Amadeus cage goblins, which makes the bridge and courtyard fights much easier.

achievements.description: Complete Deadly Dustland
achievements.summary: Complete Deadly Dustland.

steps.text: Reach the end of @loc{Deadly Dustland} past the mummy graves and the mirrored sun-beam rooms.

achievements.description: Complete Belly of the Beast
achievements.summary: Complete Belly of the Beast.

steps.text: Reach the end of @loc{Belly of the Beast} using Low Gravity Fields to cross the acid and tentacles.

achievements.description: Complete Brackenridge Rise
achievements.summary: Complete Brackenridge Rise.

steps.text: Reach the top of @loc{Brackenridge Rise} and fit the propellers to the flying machine.

achievements.description: Complete Cloudy Isles
achievements.summary: Complete Cloudy Isles.

steps.text: Reach the end of @loc{Cloudy Isles} past the machine and the electrified water.

achievements.description: Complete Goblin Machinations
achievements.summary: Complete Goblin Machinations.

steps.text: Destroy the Goblin Machine's weapons in @loc{Goblin Machinations}, then defeat Wheeze the Goblin.
Shoot Explosive Arrows into the joint where each weapon arm meets the body; block or dodge between reloads.

achievements.description: Collect all level experience in The Heroes Return
achievements.summary: Collect every level-experience pickup in The Heroes Return.

guide.context: Only the green level-experience pickups count; enemy kills are tracked separately. The @loc{Choose Level} screen shows a per-level counter, so a missed pickup can be recovered by replaying the expansion level.

steps.text: Clear the tavern and shoot the barrels, then grapple out the window and use the Kitesail for the sky pickups.
Deploy Zoya's Low Gravity Field so boxes float, and build a route up to the high sky pickups.
Use Monster Prison and the catapult area, then ride the airflow with the Kitesail for the next pickups.
Cross the bridge, stack caged goblins, and collect the pickup clusters and moving-platform pickups.
Use the gravity fields and water flow to reach the rooftop pickups, then explore the well and cogs.
Collect the courtyard, wall and fountain pickups, then finish around the boss tower.

achievements.description: Collect all level experience in Deadly Dustland
achievements.summary: Collect every level-experience pickup in Deadly Dustland.

guide.context: Only the green level-experience pickups count; enemy kills are tracked separately. The @loc{Choose Level} screen shows a per-level counter, so a missed pickup can be recovered by replaying the expansion level.

steps.text: Glide from the statue and cross the sandworm areas, collecting the obvious pickups and the plank and box climbs.
Grapple and swing through the ruins, divert the sun beam with the crystal, and clear the pillar and boulder sections.
Work through the mummy graves, the wheel and the hidden treasure rooms, using gravity fields for the high pickups.
Align the mirrors and sun beams, then cross the collapsible platforms and cog sections.
Trap the scorpion's tail in the ground, then use the boxes and plank to reach the pickups beyond it.
Clear the mummy rooms and the spike-ball room, then finish the ceiling-button and mirror puzzle for the last pickups.

achievements.description: Collect all level experience in Belly of the Beast
achievements.summary: Collect every level-experience pickup in Belly of the Beast.

guide.context: Only the green level-experience pickups count; enemy kills are tracked separately. The @loc{Choose Level} screen shows a per-level counter, so a missed pickup can be recovered by replaying the expansion level.

steps.text: Use Low Gravity Fields on the ceiling sacks to traverse the stomach and collect the acid-area pickups.
Shoot the sacks quickly to make platforms appear, then use the bouncy tongue and ball launches for pickups.
Destroy the connective tissue to open tunnels, and use fields and planks to cross the acid flows.
Distract the ceiling tentacles with conjured objects while collecting the pickups they guard.
Light the tentacles by pulling them together to reveal the lower platform and its pickups.
Find the hidden ledge tunnel below for a poem and pickups, then cross the closing membranes and worm rooms for the rest.

achievements.description: Collect all level experience in Brackenridge Rise
achievements.summary: Collect every level-experience pickup in Brackenridge Rise.

guide.context: Only the green level-experience pickups count; enemy kills are tracked separately. The @loc{Choose Level} screen shows a per-level counter, so a missed pickup can be recovered by replaying the expansion level.

steps.text: Grapple the tree and climb it with fields and boxes, then take the branch and sky pickups.
Use the snowy updraft and Explosive Arrows to collect the pit and far-side pickups.
Cross the water wheel and fight the stone golem, then use the tower, mushroom and airflow pickups.
Ride the lifts and gravity fields to the spire pickups, then clear the mine cart and track sections.
Collect the workshop, conveyor and hidden-room pickups, then fit the propellers to finish the level.

achievements.description: Collect all level experience in Cloudy Isles
achievements.summary: Collect every level-experience pickup in Cloudy Isles.

guide.context: Only the green level-experience pickups count; enemy kills are tracked separately. The @loc{Choose Level} screen shows a per-level counter, so a missed pickup can be recovered by replaying the expansion level.

steps.text: Break the rocks and vines near the river, then use fields and planks to reach the cave and sky pickups.
Use the barrel, boxes and floating platforms around the large lake, then solve the electrified-water puzzle to dive for the underwater pickups.
Use the red gate and the bell sequence, then glide from the dragon's head for the next pickups.
Ride the moving platforms and use fields to reach the pickups around the wyverns and golem.
Use the machine arms, magnetized planks and ice arrows to cross the water and reach the peak pickups.

achievements.description: Find all chests in the Goblin Menace expansion
achievements.summary: Open every secret chest in the Goblin Menace expansion.

guide.context: The five expansion levels from The Heroes Return through Cloudy Isles each hide two chests; Goblin Machinations has none. The chests carry map pieces that unlock @loc{Dwarven Caverns}.

steps.text: Open both chests in each expansion level from The Heroes Return through Cloudy Isles.
Use @loc{Choose Level} to replay any expansion level whose chest count is not two.

achievements.description: Find all level experience in any level in the expansion
achievements.summary: Collect every level-experience pickup in at least one Goblin Menace level.

guide.context: Any expansion level with level experience qualifies; Goblin Machinations has none. The @loc{Choose Level} screen shows the per-level counter.

steps.text: Choose an expansion level and gather every green level-experience pickup in it.

achievements.description: Collect all level experience in the Goblin Menace expansion
achievements.summary: Collect every level-experience pickup in the Goblin Menace expansion.

guide.context: Only the five expansion levels with pickups count; Goblin Machinations has none. Use @loc{Choose Level} to audit each counter.

steps.text: Take every level-experience pickup in the five expansion levels that contain them, from The Heroes Return through Cloudy Isles.
Replay any expansion level whose experience counter is not full.

achievements.description: Earn all Achievements in Trine 2: The Goblin Menace
achievements.summary: Earn every achievement in Trine 2: The Goblin Menace.

guide.context: This unlocks once the last remaining Goblin Menace achievement is earned.

steps.text: Unlock every other Goblin Menace achievement; this one unlocks last.

achievements.description: Capture three different types of enemies inside boxes and stack them on top of another
achievements.summary: Capture three different enemy types in Monster Prisons and stack the caged enemies on top of one another.

guide.context: Goblins have the most variants and spawn in groups, so they are the easiest family to stack.

steps.text: As Amadeus, use Monster Prison to capture three different enemy types.
Levitate the caged enemies into a stack one on top of another.

achievements.description: Collect all experience pickups in both the main game and the Goblin Menace expansion
achievements.summary: Collect every level-experience pickup in both the base game and the Goblin Menace expansion.

guide.context: This unlocks only after the base-game and expansion experience counters are all full, so finish Master Collector and Goblin Menace Collector first.

steps.text: Complete every base-game level-experience collection from The Story Begins through Icewarden Keep.
Complete every expansion level-experience collection from The Heroes Return through Cloudy Isles.

achievements.description: Kill a grenadier goblin with its own cannonball
achievements.summary: Kill a grenadier goblin using the cannonball it fired.

guide.context: Grenadier goblins first appear in @loc{The Heroes Return}. Shooting the cannonball back does not count; it must explode against the goblin.

steps.text: Catch a fired cannonball with Pontius' gravity shield or Amadeus' levitation.
Push the cannonball into the grenadier goblin and wait for it to explode on its own.

achievements.description: Make a sandworm kill another sandworm
achievements.summary: Make one sandworm kill a second sandworm with its acid.

guide.context: Sandworms only appear in @loc{Deadly Dustland}. It takes roughly six or seven acid hits to kill one.

steps.text: Stand between two sandworms and dodge so that one worm's acid spray hits the other.
Keep baiting the worms to fire into each other until one dies to the other's acid.

achievements.description: Launch an object with Knight's magnetic shield and break it with hammer before the object touches the ground
achievements.summary: Launch an object with the Knight's magnetic shield, then smash it with the hammer before it reaches the ground.

guide.context: A conjured box is easy to launch and break. Switch to the hammer as soon as the box leaves the shield.

steps.text: As Pontius, aim the magnetic shield upward under a conjured box and fire it into the air.
Switch to the hammer and throw it up into the falling box before the box lands.

achievements.description: Complete any level of the Goblin Menace expansion with hardcore mode on and difficulty set to hard
achievements.summary: Finish one Goblin Menace level on Hard difficulty with hardcore mode enabled.

guide.context: Hardcore must be enabled before the attempt, with no revives. @loc{The Heroes Return} is the easiest expansion level for this.

steps.text: Replay an expansion level with difficulty set to Hard and hardcore mode turned on.
Complete @loc{The Heroes Return} without losing a hero.

achievements.description: Complete each expansion level using only one character
achievements.summary: Finish every Goblin Menace level using only one hero per level.

guide.context: The hero may differ between levels; only switching mid-level invalidates the run. On @loc{Brackenridge Rise} the Zoya route is bugged, so use Amadeus, and @loc{Goblin Machinations} cannot be finished with Amadeus because he cannot damage Wheeze.

steps.text: Choose one hero for each expansion level before starting; Amadeus is recommended for Brackenridge Rise and a different hero for Goblin Machinations.
Complete all six expansion levels without switching heroes inside any level.

achievements.description: Complete the Goblin Menace expansion on hard using hardcore mode
achievements.summary: Finish every Goblin Menace level on Hard difficulty with hardcore mode enabled.

guide.context: Hardcore gives no revives, and the expansion's bosses and fights are the hardest content for this. Playing co-op makes the combat noticeably easier.

steps.text: Start the expansion on Hard with hardcore mode turned on.
Complete all six Goblin Menace levels without losing a hero, ending with @loc{Goblin Machinations}.

achievements.description: Throw a box with Pontius' magnetic shield and catch it or have another player catch it
achievements.summary: Launch a conjured box straight up with the magnetic shield, then catch it as it falls.

guide.context: A solo catch works: send the box vertically, then step under its landing spot with the shield held out.

steps.text: As Pontius, aim the magnetic shield straight up under a conjured box and launch it vertically.
Move directly under the falling box and let it land on the shield.

achievements.description: Create a makeshift raft of three separate parts and have a goblin sail it for five seconds
achievements.summary: Build a raft from three separate parts and keep a goblin riding it for five seconds.

guide.context: Use two coconuts and one platform as the three parts. Zoya's invisibility stops the goblin from walking away.

steps.text: In @loc{Searock Castle}, carry two coconuts as Amadeus to the water's edge on the right before the first combat area.
Bring one of the first goblins back to the coconuts and place a platform on top of them, then stand the goblin on the platform.
Switch to Zoya and use invisibility so the goblin stays on the raft for five seconds.

achievements.description: Glide for five seconds with Kitesail Shield while having an object or character on top of the shield
achievements.summary: Keep the Kitesail Shield gliding for five seconds while an object or another hero rides on top of it.

guide.context: You need height and a way to stay airborne, such as Zoya's low-gravity field or an air vent.

steps.text: Have Pontius launch from a high point into a low-gravity field or an air vent so the Kitesail keeps gliding.
Have Zoya jump onto the shield, or place an object or hero on it, and keep gliding for five seconds.

achievements.description: Kick five enemies of the same kind into a bottomless pit with the Thief's grappling hook kick or the Knight's Kitesail Shield glide kick
achievements.summary: Kick five enemies of one type off a ledge into a bottomless pit with Zoya's grapple kick or Pontius' Kitesail glide kick.

guide.context: Progress is cumulative and carries across levels and sessions. @loc{Icewarden Keep} and @loc{Deadly Dustland} have suitable ledges.

steps.text: In @loc{Deadly Dustland}, cage the undead goblin mummies as Amadeus and carry them to the right edge.
Open a cage, then air-kick the mummy off the edge as Pontius with the Kitesail glide kick; repeat on five mummies.

achievements.description: Capture a goblin in a Monster Prison and then launch it with a catapult
achievements.summary: Cage a goblin with the Monster Prison skill, then fire it from a catapult.

guide.context: Catapults appear in @loc{The Heroes Return}, and Amadeus must own the Monster Prison skill to cage a goblin.

steps.text: As Amadeus with Monster Prison, draw a box around a goblin to capture it.
Levitate the caged goblin onto the catapult mechanism and fire it.

achievements.description: Find all secret chests in The Heroes Return
achievements.summary: Find both secret chests in The Heroes Return.

guide.context: Each Goblin Menace level from 1 to 5 hides two secret chests, each holding a collectible poem or painting. The chests also hold map pieces; collecting every piece unlocks the secret @loc{Dwarven Caverns} level, and the @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks chests per level.

steps.text: After the Kitesail and airflow stretch past the bridge, open the chest holding the @item{poem}.
After the underwater spinning-cog corridor, open the chest holding the @item{painting}.

achievements.description: Find all secret chests in Deadly Dustland
achievements.summary: Find both secret chests in Deadly Dustland.

guide.context: Each Goblin Menace level from 1 to 5 hides two secret chests, each holding a collectible poem or painting. The chests also hold map pieces; collecting every piece unlocks the secret @loc{Dwarven Caverns} level, and the @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks chests per level.

steps.text: To the left of the statue and flame-trap area, open the chest holding the @item{painting}.
In the spike-ball room, raise the pillars with Amadeus, pass under before they fall, and open the chest holding the @item{poem}.

achievements.displayName: Secrets of Belly of the Beast
achievements.description: Find all secret chests in Belly of the Beast
achievements.summary: Find both secret chests in Belly of the Beast.

guide.context: Each Goblin Menace level from 1 to 5 hides two secret chests, each holding a collectible poem or painting. The chests also hold map pieces; collecting every piece unlocks the secret @loc{Dwarven Caverns} level, and the @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks chests per level.

steps.text: Drop down the hidden fleshy tunnel below the decorative ledge and open the chest holding the @item{poem}.
Set up a Low Gravity Field plus a plank over the floor ball, then release the ball to fling yourself up to the chest holding the @item{painting}.

achievements.description: Find all secret chests in Brackenridge Rise
achievements.summary: Find both secret chests in Brackenridge Rise.

guide.context: Each Goblin Menace level from 1 to 5 hides two secret chests, each holding a collectible poem or painting. The chests also hold map pieces; collecting every piece unlocks the secret @loc{Dwarven Caverns} level, and the @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks chests per level.

steps.text: In the hidden tunnel reached after dropping below the wooden ramps, open the chest at the bottom left for the @item{painting}.
In the hidden room reached from the broken-bridge area, use the flame, water and a plank to open the chest holding the @item{poem}.

achievements.description: Find all secret chests in Cloudy Isles
achievements.summary: Find both secret chests in Cloudy Isles.

guide.context: Each Goblin Menace level from 1 to 5 hides two secret chests, each holding a collectible poem or painting. The chests also hold map pieces; collecting every piece unlocks the secret @loc{Dwarven Caverns} level, and the @loc{Choose Level} screen tracks chests per level.

steps.text: Shoot an Explosive Arrow through the rocks below the cart, glide down, and open the first secret chest.
At the machine and platform peak, swing across to the second secret chest.
